And if you will go to the advanced level then what kind of project can you work on? You can work on data science project, artificial intelligence, machine learning or database administration. That's why you selected that particular language. When you select programming language then you should also get the question in your mind that what kind of application is made in that programming language. Or why is Ruby used for backend? Why is JavaScript used for frontend? If I is Javascript used for front-end, what will happen if I use Ruby for front-end. What will I learn for full stack development.
